items.title: Ernest 'Punch' Miller Interview, 1960-08-23
items.q: Yes, I'm talkin' about Eddie Jackson.

ctx.x: That's what I'm talkin' about, Eddie Jackson.

items.title: Ernest 'Punch' Miller Interview, 1960-04-04
items.q: Well this guy named Jackson, you should play tuba? Eddie Jackson.

ctx.x: boards? Yeah I worked with Gus Lotz. That day that there was only one trumpet, who was

your baritone player? Oh no, he was a good guy, so tall guy. He was a little bit of a trumpet player. Well this guy named Jackson, you should play tuba? Eddie Jackson. Well this guy was Kent to him, he the one who got in front of him, trumpet player. I forgot his name now, he's a much younger fella than we all was, but he played that baritone there,
they played nice too. How big a brass band would they use in those days?
